name: tape-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for tape — Phase 5.3 critical-path coverage + Phase 5.5 client-side frame-budget load test. The CI-gated specs are deterministic: they drive the chart through the dev-only window.__tapeStore snapshot-injection hook and a mocked WebSocket, so no backend (Docker / Postgres / Rust worker) is required. The single live spec hitting a real /ws/stream is tagged @live and skipped unless TAPE_E2E_LIVE=1.
